name: Basilica of St. James
history: Catholics settled around Jamestown from 1872, and the first Mass in town was said on 10 January 1879. The first church, finished in 1882, briefly served as the cathedral of a new diocese before the see moved to Fargo in 1897. The present church was designed by the Hancock Brothers of Fargo and consecrated on 29 November 1914. It became a basilica in 1988.
arch: A cross-shaped Gothic Revival church in Hebron brick with Bedford stone trim on a granite foundation. Twin towers 125 feet tall flank the front.
features: The tower spires are capped with crosses in 23-carat gold leaf.
Its stained glass, showing the life of Christ, was installed by the Pittsburgh Plate Glass Company in 1918.

look.d: Both spires carry crosses gilded in 23-carat gold leaf.

fun: This prairie church was briefly a cathedral, before the bishop's seat moved to Fargo.
journal: Twin spires over the North Dakota prairie, gold crosses catching the wind.
